entities.summary: Gullstein Church is a parish church of the Church of Norway in Aure Municipality in Møre og Romsdal county, Norway. It is located in the village of Gullstein, on the western coast of the island of Tustna. It is the main church for the Tustna parish which is part of the Ytre Nordmøre prosti (deanery) in the Diocese of Møre. The white, wooden church was built in a long church design in 1869 by the architect Christian Christie. The church seats about 300 people.
